messages:
maya: paging — alerting: us-east1 GPU pool saturation, queue growth > 5k requests, autoscaler failing to spin new nodes (quota errors). Getting a lot of 429s and client reports. oncall-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: GPU_CAPACITY_EXHAUSTION_us-east1 (sev2) — paging @oncall
oncall-bot: PagerDuty alert: PD-4312 assigned to sam
sam: I’m on it. quick status? logs?
maya: autoscaler logs show repeated GCE quota_denied during instance_create: "RESOURCE_QUOTA_EXCEEDED" starting 1903456702. Batches accumulating in FIFO queue.
david: visible at the proxy layer too — connection queue length spike and request latencies > 5s. Some routes already in degrade-mode (rate-limited) showing 503s.
jia: working hypothesis: regional quota + cloud image provisioning latency; autoscaler retried a few times then backoff increased so we didn’t hit desired capacity.
sam: Can we enable cross-region spillover to eu-west1 now? What’s the current routing policy? ops-bot: Current policy: prefer primary region, fallback to compatible model variants in other regions if primary latency > 2s and healthy pool available. Automated spillover disabled for customers with strict_region flag.
sam: For now, enable manual spillover for non-strict customers and open a temporary routing override for internal traffic. maya: doing that — flipping routing override to allow spillover to eu-west1 for default model variants. Command:
```
redwoodctl routing override set --from us-east1 --to eu-west1 --model=* --reason "emergency capacity" --ttl 1h
```
maya: routing override accepted. Starting gradual 10% traffic shift.
eli: noted some model variant incompatibilities — certain quantized builds not available in eu-west1. We’ll keep a fallback to scaled CPU-batched endpoints in eu-west1 for those variants. sam: start throttling low-priority traffic (background embeddings & batch jobs). Who can push rate-limit changes?
david: I can update token-based quotas. Pushing throttle policy now — 30% reduction for embedding endpoints and queue-priority demotion for non-interactive jobs.
ops-bot: Throttle policy applied: embeddings reduced by 30%. Background jobs marked low-priority.
maya: autoscaler is still failing to create more nodes in us-east1 due to combined quota and intermittent GCE API 500s. Cloud console shows project quota at limit for NVIDIA A100s. sam: Can we request quota increase? That takes hours. Any faster mitigation? jia: We can temporarily reassign some dedicated capacity from staging pools in us-east1 to production — requires approval.
sam: Approve — we need emergency capacity. maya: reallocating 2 GPU hosts from staging pool-2 to production pool-main. Command:
```
infractl pool move --from staging-pool-2 --to prod-pool-main --count 2 --force
```
maya: move initiated. Hosts show provisioning but will take ~3-5min to be available. eli: be careful — reassigning will evict some staging jobs. Notifying CS.
cs-rep: ping — notifying affected customers on staging runs, ETA ~5m. Sending template note now.
cs-rep: message sent to staging customers: "We're moving capacity to prioritize production traffic due to a regional surge. Expected disruption: short interruptions for scheduled non-production jobs."
sam: after the pool move, we should observe some relief in queues. Meanwhile continue spillover ramp to eu-west1 to handle the extra 40% sustained traffic.
maya: prod pool hosts became active at 1903456905 — observed immediate drop in queue depth by ~18%. Combined with spillover the 95th pct latency dropped from 7.2s to 2.4s over 4 minutes.
oncall-bot: NOTE: manual handoff requested — sam -> jia for extended monitoring window (30m). Sam: handoff accepted. jia: I’m monitoring logs and autoscaler metrics, will keep pagers open.
jia: still seeing a few 500s from GCE image service causing slow instance init. Working with cloud support escalations via chat. Also seeing cache warmup penalties when traffic hits eu-west1 for certain models — KV cache priming causing spikes.
eli: mitigation for cache warmup: enable prefix caching & warmup for hot model keys in eu-west1 and pre-populate KV from snapshot. Command:
```
modelctl kv warmup --region eu-west1 --model gpt-3x-like --keys-file /tmp/hot_keys.txt
```
eli: warmup scheduled, ETA 2m.
maya: observed client error rate drop and successful routing to eu-west1 for compatible variants. Some customers with strict_region flag still hit rate limits — CS is compiling list.
cs-rep: compiling list now; immediate outreach to affected enterprise customers in 10m with mitigation plan and ETA.
sam: plan for next 1h: 1) keep manual routing override in place 2) keep throttles on background jobs 3) monitor autoscaler quota status and cloud support updates 4) follow up with CS on affected customers 5) post-incident blameless review tomorrow.
jia: cloud support responded — they increased soft quota on A100 by 5 units temporarily for emergency (ticket #CS-998). That should allow autoscaler to provision more nodes; continue to monitor.
maya: autoscaler now creating instances again at 1903457520. Queue draining observed. Will start removing temporary throttles slowly once stable.
ops-bot: ROUTING OVERRIDE TTL 1h expires at 1903460389 (set by maya). Consider renewing if still needed.
sam: good work everyone. Keep the channel updated with any regressions. Handing off final watch to jia at 1903458000. jia: taking watch. I’ll post a slack update in 15m with status. :thumbsup:
jia: 15m status — queue reduced to 400 requests, 95th latency 1.1s, autoscaler healthy. Keeping override until end of TTL, will recommend renewal or controlled rollback in 30m.
maya: filing preliminary incident note and will start timeline. Postmortem owners: maya (writeup), sam (remediation ops), jia (autoscaler fixes).
cs-rep: sent outbound customer updates to affected enterprise accounts; some customers asked for a root-cause timeline and SLA credits — documenting.
sam: action items captured. Closing active paging but keeping channel live for watch until override TTL or until jia signals all-clear. Thanks all.
